app.loadErrorBody: Check your connection and try again.
app.setupBody: Copy .env.example to .env.local, start Supabase (npm run db:start) and fill in the URL and the anon key from npx supabase status.

auth.title: Welcome
auth.tagline: Train, eat and track your progress in one place.
auth.modeLabel: Sign in or create an account
auth.resetSent: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way.
auth.confirmEmail: Check your inbox to confirm your email, then sign in.
auth.legal: By continuing you accept the terms and the privacy policy.

goal.title: Your goal
goal.subtitle: We use it to suggest your daily calories.

body.title: About you
body.subtitle: Used only to calculate your calorie target.
body.name: Name
body.underage: You must be 18 or older to use this app.

lifestyle.title: Your routine
lifestyle.subtitle: Helps us set a realistic calorie target and a starting plan.

target.title: Your daily target
target.subtitle: Change it if you like. You can edit it any time in Diet.
target.safety: Targets below 1,500 kcal or a deficit over 25% are blocked. For those, follow a plan from a nutrition professional.

mode.title: How you track food
mode.subtitle: You can switch any time in Diet goals.
mode.trackingDetail: Log every food you eat, by search or barcode.
mode.fixedDetail: Set your meals once, then tick them off.

meals.title: Your meals
meals.subtitle: We split your target into four meals. You can edit them any time in Diet.

consent.title: Your health data
consent.subtitle: Please read and decide.
consent.body: Weight, food, workouts and photos are health data. We store them encrypted and only to run the app. You can export or delete everything at any time in Privacy & data.
consent.health: I agree to the processing of my health data
consent.healthDetail: Required to use the app. You can withdraw it later.
